entries.080a6a730dbc3708: It holds production technology in-house and has the capability to respond to high-mix, low-volume production, and it extends improvement activities under its proprietary integrated management system “∫IΣS (Shimusu)” to development, sales, and logistics beyond production. For capacitor modules, it is advancing technology development centered on thinner films, higher withstand voltage, and improvements in lifespan and environmental resistance performance. A distinguishing feature is that the group holds technology for both capacitors, its core device, and the power electronics equipment that applies them.

entries.11d9337a2fb0ef69: Toward realizing its long-term management vision (fiscal 2019 to fiscal 2028), it is advancing Medium-Term Management Plan Phase III (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2028) under the theme “Toward Enhancing Corporate Value: From Integration to Synergy.” The basic policy of Phase III is to integrally promote optimization of the business portfolio, strengthening of profitability, productivity reform, and improvement of capital efficiency. It plans to strengthen cooperation among businesses centered on capacitor products and to create solutions that integrate the technologies of capacitors, its core device, and power electronics equipment.

entries.382f08f0eb1be236: It is an electronic components and power equipment manufacturer headquartered in Nishinomiya City, Hyogo Prefecture, with film capacitors at its core. The company sells products under the 'SHIZUKI' brand. The company operates together with 7 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 1,166. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.3b26c50970496328: This business manufactures and sells power equipment systems, including power factor correction equipment, harmonic suppression equipment, instantaneous voltage drop compensation equipment, railway feeding equipment and DC-DC converters integrated with energy storage. In addition to the company's own manufacturing and sales, consolidated subsidiary Kyūshū Shizuki Kabushiki Kaisha manufactures products, all of which the company purchases and sells. Shizuki Tekuno Sābisu Kabushiki Kaisha also belongs to this business.
